During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''skirmish''' was fought on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] over the recovery of a downed Imperial [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttle]].
